breakReminder.message: CHECKPOINT (3 machines on main): if you've finished something, commit + PUSH it now — don't save it all for end of day. Before starting a NEW area, PULL first. Work room-by-room (one person per file) to avoid conflicts.

hooks.command: git fetch --all --prune 2>&1; echo ---; git pull --ff-only 2>&1; echo ---; git status 2>&1; echo ---; [ -f .env ] || echo 'FIRST-TIME SETUP ON THIS MACHINE: no .env found. Copy .env.example to .env and fill in the values (.env is gitignored).'; echo ---; if [ -f .env ] && grep -q '^MACHINE_NAME=.\+' .env; then name=$(grep '^MACHINE_NAME=' .env | cut -d= -f2-); owner=$(grep '^MACHINE_OWNER=' .env | cut -d= -f2-); echo "THIS MACHINE'S HANDOFF.md IDENTITY: '$name' (owner: $owner). Only ever read/write the '## $name — $owner' section of HANDOFF.md — never another machine's section."; else echo 'MACHINE IDENTITY NOT SET: MACHINE_NAME/MACHINE_OWNER are missing or empty in .env. Set them (see .env.example) to "Laptop A", "Laptop B", or "PC" so future sessions know which HANDOFF.md section this machine owns, instead of having to ask.'; fi; echo ---; echo 'THE ONLY DESIGN SOURCE IS reference/shadcn-ui/. Do not consult any other design system.'; echo ---; echo 'TEAM DISCIPLINE (3 machines on main): PULL before you touch a new area | one person per file | commit+PUSH small & often | PULL again right before you push.'

dirty=$(git status --porcelain); ahead=$(git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ -n "$dirty" ] || [ "$ahead" -gt 0 ]; then msg="Uncommitted or unpushed work here. Commit + PUSH before you step away, or the other machines cannot see it."; printf '{"systemMessage": "%s"}' "$msg"; fi
